<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="22" y="27" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="12" font-weight="500">21:32</text>
    <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.95">
      <rect x="319" y="17" width="3" height="8" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="324" y="14" width="3" height="11" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="329" y="11" width="3" height="14" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="334" y="8" width="3" height="17" rx="1"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="349" cy="17" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="354" cy="17" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="359" cy="17" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <line x1="347" y1="21" x2="361" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="366" y="11" width="20" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="386" y="14" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="368" y="13" width="14" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <rect x="0" y="43" width="390" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top intro header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="260" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="195" y="74" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.72" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Messenger</text>
    <text x="195" y="102" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Display" font-size="30" font-weight="700">Martha Craig</text>
    <text x="195" y="126" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.78" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15" font-weight="400">You’re friends on Facebook now</text>

    <!-- profile photo -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="195" cy="191" r="50" fill="#B07676"/>
      <circle cx="195" cy="181" r="17" fill="#E7C1AF"/>
      <rect x="171" y="198" width="48" height="34" rx="17" fill="#E7C1AF"/>
      <circle cx="181" cy="178" r="4" fill="#3A2C2A"/>
      <circle cx="209" cy="178" r="4" fill="#3A2C2A"/>
      <rect x="186" y="185" width="18" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#3A2C2A"/>
      <circle cx="232" cy="221" r="9" fill="#67CE00" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    </g>

    <!-- message bubbles -->
    <g>
      <rect x="58" y="156" width="158" height="36" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF22"/>
      <text x="74" y="179" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400">How are you doing?</text>

      <rect x="169" y="202" width="127" height="36" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF22"/>
      <text x="185" y="225" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400">Hello, Jacob!</text>

      <rect x="82" y="250" width="226" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
      <text x="100" y="275" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400">Say hi to your new friend</text>
    </g>

    <!-- decorative waves -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.23" stroke-linecap="round">
      <circle cx="78" cy="202" r="12" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="77" cy="202" r="20" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <circle cx="313" cy="186" r="10" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <circle cx="313" cy="186" r="18" stroke-width="1.1"/>
      <circle cx="326" cy="232" r="7" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Conversation preview card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="330" width="358" height="182" rx="24" fill="#111111" opacity="0.96"/>
    <rect x="18" y="332" width="358" height="182" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.03"/>
    <text x="34" y="356" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Today • 9:14 PM</text>

    <circle cx="44" cy="388" r="16" fill="#B07676"/>
    <text x="44" y="393" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Public Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="800">M</text>

    <rect x="66" y="368" width="184" height="36" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF22"/>
    <text x="82" y="391" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400">Hey Jacob, it’s Martha.</text>

    <rect x="144" y="412" width="188" height="36" rx="18" fill="#0584FE"/>
    <text x="160" y="435" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400">Want to catch up later?</text>

    <circle cx="316" cy="387" r="16" fill="#1D1D1D" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.9"/>
    <circle cx="316" cy="387" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <text x="34" y="468" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.72" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="400">She just sent you a friendly hello and a few photos from her weekend.</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="34" y="480" width="95" height="26" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF22"/>
      <text x="81.5" y="498" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="700">View Photos</text>
      <rect x="138" y="480" width="84" height="26" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF11" stroke="#FFFFFF22"/>
      <text x="180" y="498" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="700">Mute</text>
      <rect x="231" y="480" width="108" height="26" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF11" stroke="#FFFFFF22"/>
      <text x="285" y="498" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="700">Open Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Photo row -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="548" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Public Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="800">RECENT SHARED MOMENTS</text>
    <rect x="20" y="560" width="350" height="90" rx="18" fill="#111111"/>
    <rect x="24" y="564" width="84" height="82" rx="14" fill="#3D5160"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="587" r="7" fill="#FFA800"/>
    <polygon points="32,642 52,620 64,632 75,616 98,642" fill="#6EA1B8"/>
    <rect x="114" y="564" width="84" height="82" rx="14" fill="#4B3F58"/>
    <circle cx="136" cy="587" r="7" fill="#67CE00"/>
    <polygon points="120,642 140,618 152,634 164,621 196,642" fill="#7E88B6"/>
    <rect x="204" y="564" width="84" height="82" rx="14" fill="#5A4A3C"/>
    <circle cx="226" cy="586" r="7" fill="#FF5E00"/>
    <polygon points="210,642 228,623 240,631 255,616 286,642" fill="#A58C6D"/>
    <rect x="294" y="564" width="72" height="82" rx="14" fill="#394B43"/>
    <circle cx="313" cy="586" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="300,642 318,627 327,634 338,621 362,642" fill="#7DB59D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom composer -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="693" width="390" height="117" fill="#11111199"/>
    <rect x="0" y="693" width="390" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>

    <!-- composer input -->
    <rect x="16" y="709" width="276" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF18" stroke="#FFFFFF22"/>
    <text x="44" y="734" fill="#999999" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400">Aa</text>

    <!-- emoji icon -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="31" cy="729" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF00" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.85"/>
      <circle cx="27" cy="726" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="35" cy="726" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <line x1="27.5" y1="732" x2="34.5" y2="732" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- composer action icons -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.92">
      <rect x="303" y="709" width="40" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF11" stroke="#FFFFFF22"/>
      <circle cx="323" cy="729" r="6.5" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="327.7" y1="733.7" x2="332.5" y2="738.5" stroke-width="1.6"/>

      <rect x="350" y="709" width="24" height="40" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF11" stroke="#FFFFFF22"/>
      <circle cx="362" cy="729" r="6" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="362" y1="723" x2="362" y2="735" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="356" y1="729" x2="368" y2="729" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    </g>

    <!-- bottom tab bar -->
    <g>
      <rect x="0" y="810" width="390" height="34" fill="#000000"/>
      <rect x="151" y="822" width="88" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation with 5 tabs -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="58" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>

    <!-- Chats active -->
    <g transform="translate(34,768)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="44" height="34" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF12"/>
      <rect x="10" y="7" width="24" height="16" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <polygon points="18,23 20,23 18,27" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="31" cy="12" r="3" fill="#0584FE"/>
      <text x="22" y="43" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" font-weight="600">Chats</text>
    </g>

    <!-- People -->
    <g transform="translate(107,768)">
      <circle cx="22" cy="13" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
      <rect x="12" y="20" width="20" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
      <circle cx="22" cy="13" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.15"/>
      <text x="22" y="43" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.65" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" font-weight="600">People</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Discover -->
    <g transform="translate(179,768)">
      <circle cx="22" cy="15" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" opacity="0.8"/>
      <polygon points="22,9 24,14 29,15 24,16 22,21 20,16 15,15 20,14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
      <text x="22" y="43" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.65" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" font-weight="600">Discover</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Calls -->
    <g transform="translate(252,768)">
      <rect x="12" y="10" width="20" height="14" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" opacity="0.8"/>
      <polygon points="32,14 38,10 38,24 32,20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
      <text x="22" y="43" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.65" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" font-weight="600">Calls</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Menu -->
    <g transform="translate(321,768)">
      <line x1="12" y1="10" x2="32" y2="10" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="32" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="22" x2="32" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
      <text x="22" y="43" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.65" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" font-weight="600">Menu</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Decorative edge shadows and separators -->
  <rect x="0" y="300" width="390" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="0" y="518" width="390" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="0" y="684" width="390" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.06"/>
</svg>
